claims: Michael B. Jordan won Best Actor at the 2026 Oscars.
The 2026 Oscars are the 98th Academy Awards.
Michael B. Jordan won Best Actor for his dual role in the film Sinners.
The 2026 Oscars ceremony took place on March 15, 2026.
Michael B. Jordan secured the Best Actor award over competitors including Timothée Chalamet and Leonardo DiCaprio.
Timothée Chalamet was a Best Actor nominee for Marty Supreme.
